evidence: Roster semantics and decision-time availability are not encoded; 93,630 rows vary from 21 to 25 per match, one player is assigned to both teams, role flags are missing, and some roster IDs never appear in deliveries.
impact: Cannot construct a defensible eligible candidate set.
action: Acquire source documentation and authoritative availability/substitute/role data.
follow_up: Re-audit candidate eligibility after receiving roster lineage.

evidence: The dataset records outcomes for the bowler actually used, not all eligible alternatives or a recorded recommendation decision.
impact: No unbiased counterfactual candidate-ranking outcome can be scored.
action: Define and preregister a prospective or otherwise defensible evaluation target.
follow_up: Do not compute MRR/hit rate/run-prevention comparisons until outcome design is approved.

evidence: The new isolated builder consumes only matches.csv, deliveries.csv, and wicket_events.csv with strict earlier-date cutoff.
impact: Current full-history aggregate tables are excluded from historical feature construction.
action: Keep feature inputs raw-only and retain leakage assertions.
follow_up: Add expanding as-of snapshots only after candidate/outcome blockers are resolved.

evidence: Seven matches have T20 match_type but overs=50; observed maximum over is 19.
impact: Format and quota interpretations are inconsistent.
action: Exclude these records from future evaluation or correct upstream with source evidence.
follow_up: Revalidate after upstream metadata provenance is available.

evidence: Phase labels are present as Powerplay/Middle/Death, but no local derivation rule was found and shortened innings may affect boundaries.
impact: Recomputing phase from a fixed over rule may silently misclassify historical records.
action: Preserve supplied labels and obtain the phase-generation specification.
follow_up: Validate phase assignment before phase-subgroup effectiveness claims.

evidence: Phase 2 fallback code filters to legal deliveries before summing bowler-charged runs, while 41,103 source deliveries carry wides/no-balls and all are marked illegal.
impact: That fallback omits charged runs on those deliveries.
action: Do not use that fallback for the new feature reconstruction; production data/formula was not modified.
follow_up: Review separately before any production aggregate regeneration.
